Road closures and special event clearways will be in place for the City of Sydney - Sydney Streets event on Glebe Point Rd. The event runs from 11am until 10pm.

Roads in the vicinity of Glebe will begin closing at 8am and remain closed until 11:30pm. Police may restrict vehicle access along closed roads, including residents and businesses.

  • Sections of Cowper St, Derwent Ln, Derby Pl, Francis St, Glebe Point Rd, Mitchell St and Norton St are closed during this time.

Allow extra travel time, follow the directions of traffic control and be aware of increased pedestrian activity

Special event clearways are in effect from 7am until 11:30pm on sections of Glebe Point Rd, Francis St, Derby Pl, Cowper St, Norton St and Mitchell St.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

AFL: Sydney Swans v Hawthorn at the Sydney Cricket Ground in Moore Park. Gates open at 5.45pm. First bounce at 7.40pm, full-time approx 10:20pm.

With more than 40,000 fans expected, traffic will be heavy on roads approaching Moore Park during the already busy evening peak.

Motorists should expect delays and allow extra travel time on the Eastern Distributor, Moore Park Rd, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde, Oxford St and Lang Rd.

Changed traffic conditions:

  • Driver Ave will be partially closed outside the stadium from 4.45pm and will reopen after crowds have cleared the area.
  • No through-traffic will be available on Driver Avenue, however access to EP2 Kippax car park will be maintained via Moore Park Rd and access to EP3 grass car park and drop-off areas maintained from Lang Rd. Grass car parks open from 4.40pm.
  • Special event clearways will be in effect from 6am to midnight on sections of Cleveland St and Fitzroy St, from 3pm to 11pm on a section of Moore Park Rd, and from 3pm to midnight on sections of Albion St, Moore Park Rd and Lang Rd.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

The Six Foot Track Marathon is a 45km trail stretching across the Blue Mountains from the Explorer's marked tree near Katoomba to the Jenolan Caves. The Marathon started in 1984 and follows the length of the entire trail. Due to road closure for the event please use detour.

Reduced speed limits and Traffic Controllers in place along the closed section of Jenolan Caves Road at Duckmaloi Road, Boggy Creek Road / Black Range Trail, the Six Foot Track Crossing, and Jenolan Cottages. Left turn off the Great Western Highway into Nellies Glen Road at Katoomba will also be closed for a short duration during the morning of the event.
properties.diversions: Detour via Jenolan Caves Rd, Duckmaloi Rd, Oberon St, Edith Rd to travel between Hartley and Jenolan via Oberon.

Super Rugby Double Header: Waratahs v Western Force at Allianz Stadium. Women's kick-off at 5:05pm, men's kick-off at 7.35pm. Finish around 9.10pm.

Traffic will be heavier than usual on roads approaching Moore Park as fans travel to the match with a music festival on at the nearby Centennial Parklands. Allow extra travel time on roads including the Eastern Distributor, Moore Park Rd, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde and Lang Rd.

  • Driver Ave will be partially closed outside the stadium before the match from 4:30pm and will reopen once crowds have safely cleared the area after the game.
  • Additional road closures will be in place from 8:30pm on sections of Driver Ave, Lang Rd and Moore Park Rd. No access to EQ from Anzac Pde or Oxford St
  • No through-traffic will be available on Driver Avenue, however access to EP3 grass car park and drop-off areas maintained from Lang Rd. Car park open from 4.35pm. EP2 car park will not be open for this match.
  • Rugby fans will be able to exit via Driver Ave while roads are closed.

Special event clearways will be in effect from 6am to 11.30pm on sections of Cleveland St, from 11am to 11.30pm on sections of Albion St, Fitzroy St, Lang Rd, Moore Park Rd and Oxford St, from 3pm to 11pm on a section of Moore Park Rd, and from 12:01am to 11.59pm on Driver Ave.  

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.
